workr: Workflow Execution Helpers

Source: R/workr-package.R
workr-package.Rd

Standalone helpers for running assessment workflows and steps. This package extracts the workflow execution utilities from gsm.core, providing RunWorkflows, RunWorkflow, and RunStep as a lightweight runtime.
